collections.title: Collections
collections.noCollectionsHint: Create your first collection to start building your data model.
collections.hiddenHint: Hide this collection from navigation and content listings.
collections.noFieldsInSection: No fields in this section yet
collections.deleteCollectionDesc: This will permanently drop the database table and all its data. This action cannot be undone.
collections.deleteFieldDesc: This will drop the column from the database. Any stored data in this column will be lost.
collections.noRelations: No relations yet — link this collection to another
collections.removeRelationDesc: This will drop the foreign key column (or junction table) from the database. Any data in that column will be permanently lost.

relTypeDesc.many_to_one: Many {{name}} items reference one in the related collection
relTypeDesc.one_to_many: One {{name}} item is referenced by many in the related collection
relTypeDesc.many_to_many: A junction table links items from both collections
relTypeDesc.one_to_one: Each {{name}} item maps to exactly one in the related collection

onDeleteHint.set_null: Set the FK to NULL when the referenced row is deleted
onDeleteHint.cascade: Delete this row when the referenced row is deleted
onDeleteHint.restrict: Prevent deleting the referenced row while references exist

collections.setNullDisabled: Cannot set null on a required (NOT NULL) column
collections.fkHintRelated: UUID column added to the "{{table}}" table
collections.fkHintOwn: UUID column added to the "{{table}}" table
collections.displayFieldHint: Which field of “{{name}}” to show as the label instead of the UUID
collections.requiredHintAfter: — every item must reference a related record
collections.noIndexes: No indexes yet — add one to speed up queries on this collection
collections.dropIndexDesc: This removes the index from the database. The data itself is not affected, but queries relying on this index may become slower.

indexTypeDesc.btree: Standard index for filtering, sorting, and range queries. Works on any field type. Use multiple fields to create a composite index.
indexTypeDesc.fulltext: GIN index using to_tsvector. Enables fast keyword search across one or more text fields.

collections.snakeCaseError: Use lowercase letters, numbers and underscores. Must start with a letter.
collections.snakeCaseShort: Use lowercase letters, numbers and underscores.
collections.keyHint: Stored column name — snake_case, no spaces
collections.label: Label

flagDesc.required: Field must have a value when creating items
flagDesc.unique: No two items can share the same value
flagDesc.hidden: Hidden from the content editor; set via API or auto-generate
flagDesc.show_in_table: Show as a column on the content list table
flagDesc.quick_edit: Show in the quick-edit aside panel on the content list
flagDesc.readonly: Value is set on create but cannot be updated afterwards
flagDesc.translatable: Marks this field for per-language content (metadata only — i18n storage TBD)

flagDescEdit.unique: No two items can share the same value (applies DDL constraint)
flagDescEdit.translatable: Marks this field for per-language content (metadata — i18n storage TBD)

collections.autoGenHintAdd: The server will compute this field's value automatically on save.
collections.autoGenHintEdit: Server computes this field automatically on save.
collections.sourceFieldHint: The function reads this field's value to compute the result.
collections.choicesHint: Press Enter or + to add a choice.
collections.slugHint: Slug — snake_case, unique in this collection
collections.deleteSectionWithFields_one: This section has {{count}} field. Choose where to move them before deleting.
collections.deleteSectionWithFields_other: This section has {{count}} fields. Choose where to move them before deleting.
collections.deleteSectionEmpty: This section has no fields and will be removed.
collections.minOneSection: At least one section must remain
collections.sortSectionsHint: Drag to reorder — fields stay inside each section
collections.visibilityHint: When off, the section is always shown. When on, show only if the rules match.
collections.visibilityNeedsFields: Add fields to this collection before configuring visibility rules.
collections.noRules: No rules — add a rule or nested group.
